stem.text: The photomicrograph shows two blood vessels P and Q.
Both these blood vessels are part of a network which transports blood around the body.

stem.alt: Greyscale photomicrograph of two blood vessel cross-sections in tissue, the vessels labelled P and Q.

stem.text: Which row is correct for blood vessel P and blood vessel Q?

A.text: carries blood into arterioles; carries blood into arterioles

B.text: carries blood into arterioles; carries blood from venules

C.text: carries blood from venules; carries blood into arterioles

D.text: carries blood from venules; carries blood from venules
